svg.aria-label: A grid of the sky under the flat, blended and stereographic projections
svg.text: One patch of sky, three projections
Grid every 15° (lines of constant azimuth and elevation about the view centre) and circles of 8° radius at 0°, 20°, 38° and 52° off the centre
All panels scaled so 60° off the centre sits on the panel edge. Drawn with the app's Projection::project (camera/projection.rs).
